name: velvet-ui
description: Velvet UI — native-like swipeable sheets for the web. Spring physics + WAAPI.

scripts.build: npm run build:demo && npm run build:lib
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:lib && npm run types:check
scripts.verify:package: node --input-type=module --eval "const root=await import('velvet-ui'); const sheet=await import('velvet-ui/sheet'); const toast=await import('velvet-ui/toast'); if(root.Sheet!==sheet.Sheet || root.toast!==toast.toast) throw new Error('ESM export identity mismatch')" && node --eval "const root=require('velvet-ui'); const sheet=require('velvet-ui/sheet'); const toast=require('velvet-ui/toast'); if(root.Sheet!==sheet.Sheet || root.toast!==toast.toast) throw new Error('CJS export identity mismatch')"
scripts.verify:sheet: node scripts/sheet-api.mjs && node scripts/gesture-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/preview-hover.mjs && node scripts/stacking.mjs && node scripts/detent.mjs && node scripts/drag.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run types:check && npm run verify:package && npm run verify:sheet && npm run verify:toast
